# Astilba Env

Preserve public exports, deterministic generated bytes, package version 0.3.0 and the published Node support matrix. Development Node and pnpm are separate from consumer runtime pins.

Run `pnpm verify:env` from the repository root. Archive verification requires a clean local commit; run `pnpm verify:env:archive`, then the exact consumer matrix described in `docs/architecture/verification-inventory.md`. Keep artifact metadata bound to the nested package and its Git commit. Tool resolution may use the shared pnpm store but must reject paths outside the installation root.

Registry examples live under `fixtures/registry/env` and retain their own installation, lock and registry pins. Use positive and negative controls for source identity, symlink containment, exports and generated output. Do not weaken verification, change public runtime minimums or activate the imported release workflow.
